name: Uniform collapse (spherical)
blurb: Gas (gamma = 5/3) falling inward at a speed proportional to radius, u = -r, so that all of it would reach the origin at t = 1 (ExactPack’s noh2). It stays uniform as it is squeezed along its adiabat, with no shock: at t = 0.6 the density is 1 / 0.4^3 = 15.6 times its start everywhere. The cells next to the open faces are held at the exact solution: an open face alone cannot push gas in as the collapse does, and a rarefaction would run in from it at the sound speed.
